# About 

## Hi

I'm Shiyi Zhang, a first year ScM student of the Biostatisitcs Department. I graduated from Smith College with a B.A in Neuroscience. My past research experiences were mainly in the area molecular neuroscience i.e. signaling pathways of neurogenesis, molecular profile of adult neurogenesis. I used to work a lot with mice in the lab but now I tend to work with computer mice. 

## Statistics Background

I found statistics very interesting in my third year at Smith through taking the multiple regression class with Dr.  Cook. I had little experience in programming and I wish to strengthen my relationship with programming languages through this class.
